summary: Iteration 58 - Tested wallet badge shareable URL feature and cascade deletion cleanup. All backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed members, children, guests, families for cascade testing (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 58 features verified: (1) POST /api/members/{id}/wallet-badge creates wallet badge with unique 16-char token, stores in wallet_badges collection. (2) GET /api/wallet-badge/{token} is public (no auth required), returns badge data including name, role, location, country info. (3) WalletBadgePage at /badge/:token renders mobile-optimized dark badge with QR code, 58:12 branding, role label, and 'Save to Home Screen' instructions. (4) UnifiedBadge 'Wallet' button calls API and opens badge URL in new tab. (5) DELETE cascade cleanup verified: member deletion removes from task assignees and board tagged_members, unlinks user; family deletion unlinks children and guests; guest deletion removes from children parent_ids; child deletion removes from location resident_ids; user deletion cascades to tasks, boards, members, guests. (6) Frontend dataEvents.js event bus working - emitDataChanged() called on delete operations, AdminPage and TasksPage subscribe to 'data-changed' events for refresh.
